_comment: Simple story: inventory sync missed some scheduled updates this week, so it processed noticeably fewer stock updates than usual. -4% is a small-looking number, but it is well outside Wara's normal ±1-3% wobble (see wara-healthy.json's 16-week baseline), so the Usage reader flags it as a real deviation, not noise.

comment: A few customers saw the wrong stock number on product pages this week. Nothing broke, but support had to explain it more than once.
